raw_comment:
1. I noticed that the excessive drought is mostly in states that are in the middle of the U.S.
2. I wonder why there is so much drought currently in 2024 as opposed to other years where there wasn't much of a drought occurring as it is in this year.
3. This relates to me and my community because there hasn't been much rain in the area where I live with the exception of a few days out of these past few months.
4. A catchy headline: Droughts Currently Occurring in the US
